title: Call Me Burroughs: A Life

description.main: A full-length biography of William S. Burroughs by Barry Miles, written with the support of the Burroughs estate. It runs to 736 pages in the Twelve hardcover.
description.extended:
A full-length biography of the writer William S. Burroughs, published by Twelve in 2014 and described by its publisher as the first in 25 years.

Miles wrote with the support of the Burroughs estate and drew on interviews with Allen Ginsberg, Lucien Carr and Burroughs himself. The publisher says it is the first Burroughs biography to cover the last decade of his life and to examine his cultural legacy. The hardcover runs to 736 pages.

Barry Miles is a British writer who has documented the Beat circle and the London counterculture across several books, among them Ginsberg: A Biography, William Burroughs: El Hombre Invisible and Paul McCartney: Many Years from Now. He co-edited the Restored Text edition of Naked Lunch, and wrote the liner notes for the 1995 reissue of Burroughs's early spoken-word album, also titled Call Me Burroughs.

notes: Page count 736 per the publisher; Open Library lists 718. Other edition: Grand Central paperback 9781455511938 (2014). Identified from a spine photograph; edition not checked against the copy.
